source: SSA 2026 contribution and benefit base; IRS Topic 751 (Social Security and Medicare withholding rates)
note: additionalThreshold is the point at which the employer withholds additional Medicare. It is a single value and does not depend on filing status: Topic 751 says 'wages paid in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year, without regard to filing status'. The 250,000 / 125,000 thresholds belong to the final liability on the return, not to withholding.
